cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with prominent buffers Coco-Glucoside (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no reinforcing anionic. Counter-signals toward low: prominent waxy payload lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (6) and refatter Glyceryl Oleate (8) directly behind a glucoside-buffered chassis; confidence moderate (neighbor low).

C2 not met: no separate pearlizing/fatty route besides the lipid that substitutes for the silicone; so not high. Counter-signal toward high: waxy lipid + cationic polymer converge early.

excluded: Piroctone Olamine (15): anti-dandruff active, not deposition
